name: Prone Shooter (Combat)
body:
Your training with ranged attacks gives you an edge when firing while prone.

Prerequisite: Proficiency with firearms or crossbows.

Benefit: You gain a +4 bonus on ranged attack rolls made while Prone.

Normal: You only gain a +4 bonus to AC against ranged attacks for being prone.
